successors.name: Russian Empire
successors.text: the Imamate 'overthrown by the Russian Empire' in 1859, after Shamil accepted surrender terms

capitals.name: Dargo (Shamil's seats: Ashilta, Akhulgo, Dargo, Vedeno)

ledger.x: 1828: the Gazawat begins and the Imamate is established to combat the Russians.
1832-1834: Hamzat Bek brings the Avar Khanate into the Imamate.
1843: Shamil sweeps the Russian posts out of Avaria.
1859: Shamil surrenders and the Imamate falls.

wars.name: Caucasian War
wars.outcome: Russian victory over the Imamate: Shamil led the mountaineers 'from 1834 until his capture by Dmitry Milyutin in 1859'.

wars.name: Siege of Akhoulgo
wars.outcome: The siege 'claimed about 4,500 lives'; the page does not give the result or any territorial change.

wars.name: Shamil's 1843 offensive in Avaria
wars.outcome: Shamil's forces killed 486 at Untsukul on 28 August 1843 and 'took every Russian outpost in Avaria except one' in the next four weeks.

certainty.note: Mountain frontiers with no treaty or survey line; the Terek line of Russian forts and the Chechen plain were disputed ground.
